newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to tender 14 pct of Nafta-Moskva oil firm.
newsitem.headline: Russia to tender 14 pct of Nafta-Moskva oil firm.

text.p: Russia plans to hold a commercial tender for a 14 percent stake in oil trader OAO Nafta-Moskva on December 30, the Federal Property Fund said in its Reforma bulletin on Monday.
The starting price for the 116,110 shares, each with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles, is 66 billion roubles and the tender will be won by whomever offers the highest price for the shares.

The winner must invest $2.7 million in the company and give it exclusive rights for two years to sell in Russia 25,000 tonnes of lubricants made by one of three companies -- Finnish companies Neste Oy and Teboil and Britain's Burmah Castrol Plc.
It must also grant Nafta-Moskva the right to use the trade mark of the company supplying the lubricants for two years.
Nafta-Moskva's charter capital is 829.35 million roubles, divided into 588,342 ordinary shares, 240,511 preferred shares and one golden share.
Its holdings include 100 percent of Finnish companies Suomen Petrooli and Teboil, 99.9 percent of AO Nafta UK Ltd and 100 percent of Iransovneft.

Last December, Nafta-Moskva and Bank Yunibest won an auction for 15 percent of Nafta-Moskva with a bid of $20.01 million under the government's shares-for-loans scheme. The bid was guaranteed by Uneximbank.
